name: hud_cmd_dialog_state_destructor_core
description: HudCmdDialogState::DestructorCore resets the state vtable, deletes the owned command dialog through vtable slot 2 when present, clears m_dialog, and restores the base state vtable.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs produced symbol ?DestructorCore@HudCmdDialogState@@QAEXXZ with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x40bc90 after COFF relocation masking (20 relocation bytes, 10 trim nops; BN size 86, VC size 96).
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40bc90 installs g_HudCmdDialogState_Vtbl, dispatches m_dialog vtable slot 2 with flags 1 when non-null, clears m_dialog, and restores g_RecoilStateBase_Vtbl.
Native smoke verifies the null-dialog path restores the base vtable, and a test dialog vtable receives one scalar-deleting destructor call with flags 1 before m_dialog is cleared.
